item.title: ECHL players authorize strike, Indy Fuel games at risk
item.description: The ECHL players have voted to authorize their bargaining committee to call for a strike, with the strike notice to be effective Friday, due to the league's unfair bargaining practices and lack of concern for players' safety and well-being.

item.title: Hospital team brings Swiftie magic to young patient’s bedside
item.description: A 12-year-old patient at Riley Hospital for Children received a special surprise from the hospital team, who performed a Taylor Swift-themed song and decorated his room with Swiftie memorabilia, complete with a watch party for her docuseries.

item.title: Trump administration orders 2 Indiana power plants to keep burning coal
item.description: The U.S. Department of Energy has issued orders to keep two coal-burning Indiana power plants operating for an additional 90 days, citing the need for reliable power to keep the region's electric grid stable, despite the intentions of the companies to close them this month.

item.title: 16-year-old from Nineveh dies in crash near Franklin
item.description: One person was killed in a car crash in Franklin, Indiana on Wednesday morning, and the investigation is ongoing.

item.title: Mild and cloudy Christmas Day, stronger weekend system brings arctic air back | Dec. 24, 2025
item.description: Christmas Eve will be mild with dense fog and scattered showers, while Christmas Day will be cooler to the north and warmer to the south, with a return to winter cold expected early next week.

item.title: Shelbyville High School’s lighted holiday forest opens on Christmas
item.description: The Shelbyville High School Ecology Lab is hosting the Lighted Holiday Forest, a trail with over 40,000 holiday lights and 30 inflatables, on Fridays in December and on Christmas and the 26th, with funds benefiting the Shelbyville Speech and Debate club.

item.title: Santa’s magic sleigh soars across the globe as NORAD provides updates
item.description: NORAD has been tracking Santa Claus's reindeer-powered sleigh for 70 years, using the same satellites used to detect missile launches, and providing updates on his progress on Christmas Eve.

item.title: Pope Leo XIV presides over his first Christmas Eve Mass at St. Peter’s Basilica
item.description: Thousands of people gathered in Bethlehem's Manger Square to celebrate Christmas Eve, marking a return to normal life after two years of subdued celebrations due to the war in Gaza, Meanwhile, Pope Leo XIV presided over his first Christmas Eve Midnight Mass at the Vatican and Cardinal Pierbattista Pizzaballa led a procession from Jerusalem to Bethlehem.

item.title: Band’s Christmas Eve tradition brings music, joy to Indianapolis area
item.description: The Indy Christmas Caroling Big Band is a family-run tradition of spreading holiday cheer through music to those in need on Christmas Eve.

item.title: Asian Harbor serves families’ holiday tradition: Chinese food for Christmas
item.description: Asian Harbor, an Indianapolis restaurant owned by Mongolian immigrants, has become a Christmas Eve and Christmas Day tradition for many families, providing a sense of community and cultural enrichment.
